page_title: MNU 1-2 LEE | Manchester Utd v Leeds 13/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Manchester Utd can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+5' The linesman raises his flag. Casemiro (Manchester United) is adjudged offside.
90+1' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar.
90+1' The linesman points to the corner flag, Manchester Utd are going to take it.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
88' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sean Longstaff (Leeds) comes onto the pitch for Brenden Aaronson.
86' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
85' Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.

85' Casemiro (Manchester United) finds some space inside the box to connect with the resulting corner kick. He wallops the ball close to the left post, but it's finally blocked by one of the defenders. Maybe next time.
85' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Manchester Utd.

85' Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Karl Darlow, who pulls off a comfortable save!
83' The ball goes out of play and Leeds will have a goal kick.
83' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) prepares to take a corner kick.
82' Ilia Gruev (Leeds) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
80' The ball is crossed into the box and Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Karl Darlow gets a glove on it to thwart him.
78' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads low to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him.
76' Jayden Bogle (Leeds) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
74' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Noah Okafor walks off the pitch to be replaced by Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds).
74' Ao Tanaka (Leeds) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Ilia Gruev.
70' Michael Carrick has decided to substitute Noussair Mazraoui and he is replaced by Diogo Dalot (Manchester United).
70' Substitution. Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) replaces Amad Diallo.

69' 1 - 2 Bruno Fernandes showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Casemiro (Manchester United) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header inside the right post. It's 1:2.
69' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Manchester Utd.

68' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Manchester Utd get a corner.
68' Manchester Utd force their opponents to concede a corner.

65' Leny Yoro (Manchester United) reacted quickly inside the box and got on the end of the resulting corner. He slammed the ball towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulled off an astonishing save to deny him.
65' The ball goes out of play. Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.

65' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. His dangerous effort is blocked by Karl Darlow, who makes a glorious save!
64' The main referee, Paul Tierney, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is given a yellow card for dissent.
63' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) skips past the defender inside the box and blasts the ball at goal, but sends the effort well wide of the right post.
61' The resulting set piece from Leeds is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
60' James Justin (Leeds) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player. Leeds have been awarded a corner kick.
58' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) outjumped his marker after a well-taken corner, but his header goes wide of the target.
58' The ball is out of play. Leeds win a corner kick.
56' RED card! Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) can’t believe it as the referee orders him from the pitch following the VAR review.

55' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United), but referee Paul Tierney must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
52' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Karl Darlow, who smothers the ball.
51' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
49' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
49' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Manchester Utd comes to nothing.
48' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) inside the box. The ball is out of play and Manchester Utd manage to earn a corner.
48' Leny Yoro (Manchester United) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Referee Paul Tierney blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Pascal Struijk (Leeds) heads the ball towards goal, but his effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' The ball goes out of play. Leeds are awarded a corner kick.
45' Ao Tanaka (Leeds) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
44' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies miles wide of the right post.
44' Manchester Utd have a corner.
44' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
40' What a wasted chance that is! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) who sends his header well wide of the left post.
39' James Justin (Leeds) has tested the patience of referee Paul Tierney and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
36' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) hammers the ball from far out, but it goes narrowly over the bar.
36' The corner from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is hurriedly cleared.
32' The resulting free kick from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
32' Paul Tierney blows for a foul after Noah Okafor (Leeds) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. It's a free kick to Manchester Utd, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
31' Manchester Utd take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
29' 0 - 2 Noah Okafor (Leeds) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Senne Lammens. 0:2.
29' Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
28' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) strikes a promising volley towards goal, but one of the defenders is quick enough to step in and make a crucial block.
27' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
26' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) was too forceful with his tackle and Paul Tierney interrupted the game to signal a free kick. There is a free kick near the sideline to Leeds.
24' Jaka Bijol (Leeds) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the right post.
23' Leeds force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
23' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
18' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) is given a yellow card.
18' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) dived to the ground without any contact with the opponent.
17' The attempt by Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) isn't very precise and Karl Darlow stops it with ease.
16' Leny Yoro (Manchester United) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
16' Manchester Utd force a corner. They send men into the box.
12' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Karl Darlow easily deals with the threat.
11' A cross from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
8' Rough tackle by Casemiro (Manchester United). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
5' 0 - 1 Goal! Noah Okafor (Leeds) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the bottom right corner. 0:1.

3' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Senne Lammens anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
1' Manchester Utd keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Manchester Utd will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Paul Tierney.
